messages:
alex: CI is red on linux-arm64 after the toolchain image bump — looks like CMake can't resolve target aliases (our :core and :core_static) during link. Failing on many downstream packages.

ci-bot: Build failed: https://ci.redwood.internal/b/12345 :red_circle: (shard 58/64)

maya: ugh, saw this too. Error says "Target \"redwood::core\" not found" — full log:
```
[ 12%] Linking CXX executable run_tests
CMake Error at /opt/toolchain/share/cmake/Modules/TargetLinkLibraries.cmake:123 (message):
  Target "redwood::core" not found.  Perhaps a missing add_library?
```

alex: that's the one. suspect the toolchain's CMake packaging changed export names or removed the export file.

sam: can someone try a minimal repro? e.g., small CMakeLists that finds package and links target alias.

devon: pinging @ryan — you rolled the toolchain image yesterday, any changes to exported package names?

ryan: I only bumped gcc + binutils, no intentional cmake-package changes. I'll look at the image diff.

maya: Quick triage: can we rerun the failing shard with the previous toolchain image to see if it's a roll regression?

alex: yes — @ci-bot can you rerun build 12345#58 with toolchain image tag v2024-05-08 (previous)?

ci-bot: Rerun scheduled: https://ci.redwood.internal/build/12345/rerun/58?toolchain=v2024-05-08 — queued :gear: 

sam: if that passes, we can bisect the image. If it fails, it's likely our packaging.

devon: here's a small repro CMakeLists I used locally, fyi:
```
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(repro)
find_package(RedwoodCore REQUIRED)
add_executable(foo main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(foo PRIVATE Redwood::Core)
```

alex: thanks. I ran that inside a container from the new image and it fails to find RedwoodCore::Redwood (alias present before).

ryan: ok digging into the image layers now. If we confirm it's the image, I'll rollback the tag on CI and open an image-fix PR.

maya: also file an issue in infra/toolchain with logs and repro so we don't lose context.

alex: I'll open the issue and a quick PR to pin toolchain on the failing CI job to v2024-05-08 while we investigate. Will include the bisect plan.

devon: sounds good. @sam can you start the bisect on the image tree once we have a pass/fail anchor?

sam: yep, will do. ETA a couple hours.

alex: thanks everyone. keeping this thread for updates — will post PR and issue links when ready. :thumbsup:
